title.native: アンデッドアンラック

description:
All Fuuko wants is a passionate romance like the one in her favorite shoujo manga. Unfortunately, her Unluck ability makes that impossible. But just as Fuuko hits rock bottom, Andy sweeps her off her feet—literally! Now she's become Andy's unwilling test subject as he works to find a way to trigger a stroke of Unluck big enough to kill him for good. However, when the pair discovers a secret organization is hunting them, it puts Andy's burial plans on hold.

(Source: VIZ Media)

node.description:
Andy is member no. 9 of the Round Table. He is a Negator with the alias Undead. His original personality is that of Victor.

Andy is a deuteragonist along with Fuuko Izumo.

Andy is insanely reckless, he enjoys attempting to die and is always looking for new methods of death. He also has a soft spot for Fuuko, who he is very protective of and gets very angry when she is hurt, to the point where he will willingly remove the card in his head to release Victor. 

Andy is a tall and muscular man, with white combed back hair. He has a card in his forehead above his left eye which causes his eye to be half-closed which has left a scar. Due to his ability, he has stopped aging around his mid-20's. He has the words DEAD END tattooed on his left shoulder, but the first D in dead is backwards. He has the number 1865 tattooed on his left pectoral as well as a scar that will not go away even when he regenerates.
~!__Age:__ 190+ in the 101st Loop!~
Member No. 2 of the Round Table.
Gina is a Negator who crossed paths with Andy over fifty years ago.
Member no. 5 of the Round Table. She lived in Russia before becoming a member. The armor she wears acts as a restraint to contain her ability.

__Gender:__ ~!Female!~

Member no. 6 of the Round Table.

Member no. 8 of the Round Table. He is the smartest member of The Union. Nico is married to [Ichico Nemuri](https://anilist.co/character/314230/Nemuri-Ichico) and has a daughter with her, [Mico Vorgeil](https://anilist.co/character/321801/Vorgeil-Mico).

Member no. 3 of the Round Table. He is a cool and carefree person that seems to not mind being in danger or even realizing he was in the first place. He's shown to be knowledgeable of guns and is a self-admitted sweets lover.
Spoil is the UMA that represents spoiling and decay.
Member no. 7 of the Round Table.

Leader of the Union. Juiz is a founder and no. 1 member of the Round Table. She is determined to kill the being on the other side of Apocalypse, gathering several Negators in order to gain enough power to defeat it, thus forming The Union.
Latla is a negator and the childhood friend of [Rip](https://anilist.co/character/180727/Tristan-Rip).
Chikara is a Negator. As he can only speak Japanese, he was discovered by the Mafia after all the world's languages were unified.
Rip Tristan is a member of Under.
Void was a Negator and a member of the Union. He along with Shen were on the mission to capture Andy and kill Fuuko.
Negator no. 4 of the Round Table. He has a quiet and nonchalant personality.
The reclusive author behind Fuuko's favorite manga *To You, From Me*.
Burn is the Phenomenon-Type UMA that represents burning.
Feng is a member of Under that seeks to collect artifacts. He wears a Chinese martial arts outfit with his hood on, obscuring his face.
Sean Datz is a member of Under. He is a Negator.

Mui is a short girl of chinese descent. She has dark purple hair with white bun covers in the back of her hair. Being Shen’s subordinate, she wears the same outfit as him. This outfit consists of a white sleeveless collared shirt with a red necktie. She also wears black baggy pants that expose the hips and black gloves that go up to her arms.
Backs, also known as Bunny, is a member of Under, and appears to be a young child who wears a large bunny costume at all times.
Creed is a large, muscular man with a cross-shaped scar on his face.

Apocalypse, also known as the Book of Revelations, is the first artifact to be discovered in the world.

Apocalypse takes the form of a medium-sized book. When the mandatory number of Negators gather around the roundtable of The Union, it gains a monstrous face along the spine and covers of the book, which consists of sharp teeth and a long tongue.
Yusai is a Japanese samurai who helped train Andy in the past. She later becomes a member of Under.
Autumn is the Concept-Type UMA that embodies the season of Autumn.

Move is the UMA that embodies movement.

It was captured and tamed by The Union and was commanded by Juiz.

UMA that embodies clothing. Clothes can take the appearance of any clothing it comes into contact with. It is a wild UMA that gets angry easily and is very full of itself. Clothes has been tamed by Andy, but still keeps true to its nature of being annoyed.

Scientist employed by the Union where she works as one of [Nico Vorgeil](https://anilist.co/character/167315/)'s assistants. She is also Nico's daughter, and the second most competent scientist behind him.

One of [Nico Vorgeil](https://anilist.co/character/167315/)'s assistants, the No. 3 scientist after [Mico](https://anilist.co/character/321801). Somewhat interested in Mico, but his jealousy over her being No. 2 is the more prevailing feeling.
Classmate and friend of Chikara.
